name: a-to-z
title: a to Z
desc: An alphabet gag where a big "Z" and "is for zero lock-in." land on orange.

name: abacus-count
title: Abacus Count
desc: Abacus beads slide along their rods to count up to 48,216.

name: absorb-stack
title: Absorb Stack
desc: A centred stack of small lines, ending in a red "on top.", on a dark brown ground.

name: accordion
title: UI Accordion
desc: A disclosure whose opened/closed state is a pure function of the timeline; the panel reveal, chevron, and background are keyframed presets.

name: accordion-unfold
title: Accordion Unfold
desc: A tight paper zigzag unfolds sideways into a flat card with the logo printed across it.

name: achievement-pop
title: Achievement Pop
desc: Stacked achievement toasts unlock one by one, the last a rare gradient-filled card.

name: acronym-expand
title: Acronym Expand
desc: An acronym expands letter by letter into 'Model Context Protocol' with an eyebrow and subhead.

name: activity-rings
title: Activity Rings
desc: Concentric activity rings lap their goal while three metrics count up beside them.

name: agent-run
title: Agent Run
desc: Animated brand-neutral AI agent run — a Thinking status and short plan, tool calls whose spinners close into checks while a timer counts real seconds, then a markdown answer with citations and a code block that streams in irregular token bursts. Light/dark themes.

name: ai-answer-sources
title: AI Answer Sources
desc: An AI answer streams in with inline citations and source chips below.

name: ai-image-grid
title: AI Image Grid
desc: An AI image generator fills a result with a generated render and Download button.

name: ai-prompt-flow
title: UI AI Prompt Flow
desc: An AI prompt composition: a prompt types into the field, the Generate button runs hover → press → loading, a skeleton shimmer reveals, then crossfades into the generated answer, and a ready toast slides in. A pure orchestrator — the shimmer is owned by the skeleton-block motion atom; every other channel comes from a composed primitive's hook.

name: alert-dialog
title: UI Alert Dialog
desc: A modal alert dialog whose opened/closed state is a pure function of the timeline; the backdrop dim and popup zoom are keyframed presets. Self-contained — pair it with the Button as a trigger (see the example).

name: anagram-shuffle
title: Anagram Shuffle
desc: Letters of one word slide into new positions to spell its anagram.

name: analytics-funnel
title: Analytics Funnel
desc: An activation funnel chart steps down while a tooltip shows breakdowns.

name: anamorphic-flare
title: Anamorphic Flare
desc: A point of light grows into a cinematic anamorphic streak that sweeps the frame and reveals the logo in its wake.

name: and-you
title: and You
desc: A list of audiences ("For the founder who...") ends on a big "and you.".

name: animated-bar-chart
title: Animated Bar Chart
desc: Bars spring up from the baseline in a staggered cascade.

name: animated-line-chart
title: Animated Line Chart
desc: Line chart whose SVG path draws on from left to right with a leading dot.

name: answer-first
title: Answer First
desc: The question "Who made this video?" is answered by a big "A pull request.".

name: app-store-listing
title: App Store Listing
desc: A phone app store listing with ratings and screenshot carousel gets an Open button.

name: area-compare
title: Area Compare
desc: Two discs compare bundle sizes while 14x smaller settles in big type.

name: ascii-dissolve
title: ASCII Dissolve
desc: Dissolve one scene into the next through a drifting field of ASCII glyphs.

name: ascii-render
title: ASCII Render
desc: Redraw a live scene as ASCII: the frame divides into glyph cells and each one becomes the character matching the brightness of the picture inside it.

name: aspect-slit
title: Aspect Slit
desc: A film-title card opens through a slit, with a serif hero line and a small caption.

name: audit-boxes
title: Audit Boxes
desc: Off-spec elements of a UI get traced with red boxes, each with the fix it needs, while an issue counter ticks up.

name: audit-core
title: Audit Core
desc: Shared kit behind the design-review components: redline rulers, issue boxes, radius arcs, token tags, layout guides, the scan band and a demo dashboard to measure.

name: axis-flex
title: Axis Flex
desc: A gradient word flexes its width and weight like an elastic variable font.

name: backdrop
title: Backdrop
desc: Configurable full-frame background (color / gradient / image / live component) with Screen Studio-style padding and a rounded, shadowed content frame.

name: balance-beam
title: Balance Beam
desc: A seesaw tips as one remocn block outweighs a pile of hours, tools and revisions.

name: band-open
title: Band Open
desc: A horizontal band opens across the frame to reveal a landscape title card.

name: band-shift
title: Band Shift
desc: Bright colour bands shift across the frame in a stagger to swap one scene for the next.

name: baseline-drop
title: Baseline Drop
desc: Words drop onto the baseline in a stagger, with a gradient streak beneath.

name: bass-drop
title: Bass Drop
desc: A trailer build-up breathes in, then drops into the big gradient logo with a tracked tagline.

name: baton-word
title: Baton Word
desc: A word is handed like a baton between scenes: "Film it in code." in pink and white.

name: bauhaus-build
title: Bauhaus Build
desc: Flat Bauhaus circles, arcs, squares and bars tumble corner over corner on a hidden grid into an asymmetric frieze, then rebuild into two friezes around an open band for the title.

name: beam-split
title: Beam Split
desc: A light beam splits a bold headline and a serif italic phrase appears in the gap.

name: beam-sweep
title: Beam Sweep
desc: A beam of light sweeps across and reveals the next headline over a glowing horizon.

name: beat-count
title: Beat Count
desc: A big thin numeral counts to 64 in steps locked to a BPM, with a small caption.

name: beeswarm
title: Beeswarm
desc: Two dot swarms, before and after, settle on an axis showing 3.4 versus 10.6.

name: before-after
title: Before After
desc: A divider sweeps across a photo to reveal the graded version of an ungraded still.

name: benchmark-race
title: Benchmark Race
desc: Lanes race on a shared clock and Remocn finishes first, shown as 12x faster.

name: bento-build
title: Bento Build
desc: A bento grid of mini feature cards builds up and spotlights tiles in turn.

name: beta-thanks
title: Beta Thanks
desc: "Remocn is out" with a green "out", thanking the beta testers below.

name: blink-cut
title: Blink Cut
desc: Words blink in a fixed rhythm before cutting to the logo and a one-line tagline.

name: block-city
title: Block City
desc: A 3D grid of blocks rises like a city skyline while +340% renders counts up.

name: block-swap
title: Block Swap
desc: A block overwrites each line with the next, ending 'Render the launch.' on a gradient pill.

name: bloom-ring
title: Bloom Ring
desc: A ring of light blooms outward from the Remocn mark and replaces the scene.

name: blueprint
title: Blueprint
desc: The product wipes left to right into a technical drawing: blueprint grid, white linework, dimension lines with ticks, labels and a red callout.

name: blur-in
title: UI Blur In
desc: A wrapper that reveals a single child with blur + opacity + a directional offset; a pure state atom, theme-independent — its context is a motion config (blur/distance/axis), not a theme.

name: blur-out-up
title: Blur Out Up
desc: Words arrive clean and depart upward with increasing blur for airy exits.

name: bokeh-title
title: Bokeh Title
desc: A serif headline sharpens out of drifting bokeh lights.

name: border-beam
title: Border Beam
desc: A beam laps the border of a dark card, then reveals 'remocn 2.0' with a logo and description.

name: boss-bar
title: Boss Bar
desc: A boss HP bar is drained by hits, then 'DEFEATED' slams in beneath 'The old workflow'.

name: bottom-up-letters
title: Bottom-Up Letters
desc: Letters rise from below in a pronounced staircase, one symbol at a time, with zero blur.

name: bounce-logo
title: Bounce Logo
desc: The wordmark bounces around the frame like an old DVD logo until it hits the corner.

name: bracket-focus
title: Bracket Focus
desc: Camera-viewfinder brackets focus in on a 1.8s render-time value over a dotted grid.

name: bracket-index
title: Bracket Index
desc: Indexed bracket labels step through words before the brackets close around the product name.

name: bracket-win
title: Bracket Win
desc: A tournament bracket resolves match by match until remocn is crowned 'CHAMPION'.

name: branch-tree
title: Branch Tree
desc: A tree branches from one component into many leaves, ending on 48 variants.

name: brand-guidelines
title: Brand Guidelines
desc: An independent 17.9-second identity film with a geometric mark, sliding palette, kinetic type specimens, and original object photography.

name: brick-mosaic
title: Brick Mosaic
desc: Toy bricks drop in row by row from the bottom with a tiny bounce, rebuilding a pixel-art logo on a baseplate.

name: browser-extension
title: Browser Extension
desc: A browser extension highlights article text and saves a summary to a list.

name: brush
title: Brush
desc: Variable-width brush ribbons for Remotion. Pressure taper, grain displacement, and spine samplers shared by the ink marks.

name: bubble-pack
title: Bubble Pack
desc: Packed bubbles for categories grow around one big gradient bubble reading 420.

name: bug-dock
title: Bug Dock
desc: "Playing on every screen you ship." with a small broadcast logo bug docking at the bottom.

name: button
title: UI Button
desc: A button whose idle/hover/press/loading/success state is a pure function of the timeline; the loading state composes the Spinner motion atom.

name: button-to-card
title: Button to Card
desc: A button expands into a store card row with product images, prices and status.

name: calendar-booking
title: Calendar Booking
desc: A cursor picks a time slot and a meeting-scheduled confirmation appears.

name: calendar-pick
title: Calendar Pick
desc: A month calendar picks a launch day, tagging dates with small event labels.

name: camera-lens
title: Camera Lens
desc: Put a scene behind real glass: resolution falls off toward the corners, highlights bloom through the optics, colour fringes at the edges — a screencast that reads as filmed rather than rendered.

name: candle-rally
title: Candle Rally
desc: Candlesticks rally past a prior high as 'ALL-TIME HIGH' lands beside a price tag.

name: canvas-presentation
title: Canvas Presentation
desc: The html-in-canvas scaffolding the canvas transitions and scene filters share: support detection, a full-screen WebGL2 shader fed either both sides of a cut or the single scene a filter wraps, and routing to a CSS fallback where the browser lacks the API.

name: caption-active-pop
title: Caption Active Pop
desc: The word being spoken turns to the accent colour and springs up in scale, then settles back as the voice moves on.

name: caption-blur-in
title: Caption Blur In
desc: Each word resolves out of a soft blur the moment it is spoken, for captions that arrive quietly.

name: caption-bounce-in
title: Caption Bounce In
desc: Each word springs up into place with a little overshoot the moment it is spoken, and the phrase builds word by word.

name: caption-core
title: Caption Core
desc: The timing engine every caption style shares: pages a timed transcript, finds the word being spoken and how far into it the voice is, and decides when a page leaves the screen.

name: caption-cube
title: Caption Cube
desc: Each new phrase turns into view as the next face of a 3D cube, the previous phrase rotating up and away on a horizontal hinge.

name: caption-dim-progress
title: Caption Dim Progress
desc: The whole phrase sits on screen dimmed and each word brightens the moment it is spoken, with no motion at all.

name: caption-drop
title: Caption Drop
desc: Each word falls into place from above and bounces as it lands the moment it is spoken, and the whole phrase drops out of frame when the speaker pauses.

name: caption-emoji
title: Caption Emoji
desc: An emoji pops up above a chosen word the moment it is spoken and stays until the phrase leaves.

name: caption-handwrite
title: Caption Handwrite
desc: Each word is inked in by hand from left to right at the pace it is spoken, every word sitting at its own slight angle.

name: caption-highlight-box
title: Caption Highlight Box
desc: A solid box travels behind the word being spoken, sliding from word to word as the voice moves on.

name: caption-karaoke
title: Caption Karaoke
desc: Transcript captions where each word fills with colour left to right exactly as it is spoken, the whole phrase readable before the voice reaches it.

name: caption-knockout
title: Caption Knockout
desc: A solid plate with the words cut clean through it, each word punching out the moment it is spoken so the footage shows through the letters.

name: caption-label-maker
title: Caption Label Maker
desc: Each phrase is punched letter by letter into a strip of embossing tape at the pace it is spoken, the tape feeding out as the words arrive.

name: caption-marker
title: Caption Marker
desc: Plain captions where the words that matter get a highlighter swipe the moment they are spoken.

name: caption-outline
title: Caption Outline
desc: Heavy-stroked captions that stay readable over any footage, with the spoken word switching to a contrast colour and nothing else moving.

name: caption-prosody
title: Caption Prosody
desc: Word size follows the delivery, so drawn-out words land large and rushed words stay small, and the rhythm of the voice is visible with the sound off.

name: caption-redact
title: Caption Redact
desc: The whole phrase starts blacked out like a declassified file, and each bar pulls away the moment its word is spoken.

name: caption-rise
title: Caption Rise
desc: Each word slides up out of a mask at its baseline the moment it is spoken, with no bounce and no scale.

name: caption-scramble
title: Caption Scramble
desc: Each word arrives as random glyphs at the moment it is spoken and decodes left to right into the real letters.

name: caption-slice
title: Caption Slice
desc: Each word arrives cut in two, the top half sliding in from the left and the bottom from the right, locking together the moment it is spoken.

name: caption-slot
title: Caption Slot
desc: One short line at a time, each new phrase rolling up into place as the previous one rolls out the top.

name: caption-speaker
title: Caption Speaker
desc: Dialogue captions where every phrase takes its speaker's colour, so a conversation reads like a script.

name: caption-split-flap
title: Caption Split Flap
desc: Every letter sits on its own flap tile and clatters through a few characters before landing the moment the word is spoken, like a station departure board.

name: caption-stack
title: Caption Stack
desc: Kinetic captions stacked a couple of words per line, with the keyword of each page set large on its own line.

name: caption-stamp
title: Caption Stamp
desc: Plain captions where the words that matter slam down as a rubber stamp the moment they are spoken.

name: caption-subtitle
title: Caption Subtitle
desc: Classic broadcast subtitles, a whole phrase on a translucent plate, with no word-level animation at all.

name: caption-teleprompter
title: Caption Teleprompter
desc: The whole transcript scrolls smoothly through a short window with the current line centred, past lines fading above and the next line waiting below.

name: caption-timeline
title: Caption Timeline
desc: The whole transcript laid out on a scrolling time strip that slides under a fixed playhead, so every pause shows up as space between words.

name: caption-typewriter
title: Caption Typewriter
desc: Each word types out character by character at the pace it is spoken, with a caret that blinks while the speaker pauses.

name: caption-underline
title: Caption Underline
desc: A bar slides under the word being spoken, travelling from word to word while the text itself stays untouched.

name: caption-weight
title: Caption Weight
desc: The word being spoken swells from a light weight to a heavy one and relaxes as the voice moves on, with no layout shift.

name: caption-word-pop
title: Caption Word Pop
desc: One large word at a time, each popping in on a spring the moment it is spoken.

name: card-create
title: Card Create
desc: A phone app issues a yellow debit card and flips through color options.

name: card-fan
title: Card Fan
desc: Colourful format cards fan out of a stack with a "Your top formats" caption.

name: card-push-line
title: Card Push Line
desc: A prompt card with a slash command pushes forward as its text line types.

name: card-swipe-cover
title: Card Swipe Cover
desc: A card swipes across and covers the frame to reveal a grid of launch-kit cards.

name: caret
title: UI Caret
desc: A blinking text caret — a controlled vertical bar, or a pure motion atom that blinks deterministically from useCurrentFrame.

name: caret-collapse
title: Caret Collapse
desc: The typing caret in a prompt box collapses into the next scene.

name: caret-dolly
title: Caret Dolly
desc: A prompt box types a request while the camera dollies along the caret.

name: caret-letter
title: Caret Letter
desc: A blinking caret types a word and turns into its letter l: 'launch'.

name: caret-swap
title: Caret Swap
desc: A gradient caret swells into a block that consumes the first phrase right-to-left, collapses back and types the second phrase out with a blinking caret.

name: caret-wipe
title: Caret Wipe
desc: Sweep a typing caret across the frame, wiping the outgoing scene into the next.

name: carry-count
title: Carry Count
desc: A big counter reaches 13,580 with a small caption, "scenes students built in week one".

name: cart-add
title: Cart Add
desc: A shop page picks a color and size, then a cart drawer slides in with Checkout.

name: case-flip
title: Case Flip
desc: A headline flips letter by letter from lower to upper and back to its final casing.

name: cell-divide
title: Cell Divide
desc: A grid of dots doubles by cell division up to a count of 64.

name: centered-word-build
title: Centered Word Build
desc: Words appear sharply from below while the centered phrase pushes cumulatively closer on every beat, then clears through a soft left-to-right opacity wipe.

name: changed-mind
title: Changed Mind
desc: A big serif pull quote, "The only tool I use now.", with a solo-founder attribution.

name: changelog-scroll
title: Changelog Scroll
desc: A changelog list scrolls and one row enlarges into a highlighted headline entry.

name: channel-reactions
title: Channel Reactions
desc: A team chat channel where a launch message collects emoji reactions and replies.

name: chaos-to-order
title: Chaos to Order
desc: Scattered windows, notes and toasts drop in, then snap into an organized issue tracker.

name: chart-morph
title: Chart Morph
desc: A line chart with an area fill morphs between points up to a 46k value.

name: chat-flow
title: UI Chat Flow
desc: A messaging composition: an outgoing message types into the composer, the send button presses, and the bubble rises in; the other side shows a typing indicator that swaps into the reply, and reactions pop in. A pure orchestrator — every channel comes from a composed primitive's hook (Input, MessageBubble, TypingIndicator).

name: chat-gpt
title: ChatGPT
desc: Animated ChatGPT composer — types a prompt into the pill input, the blue voice button morphs into a send button, and the suggestion chips fade out. Light/dark themes.

name: chat-to-preview-layout
title: Chat to Preview Layout
desc: Two-column layout where chat shrinks and preview expands.

name: check-list
title: Check List
desc: A handwritten checklist that writes itself out in full, then ticks and strikes through every done item, one at a time.

name: checkbox
title: UI Checkbox
desc: A checkbox whose checked/unchecked state is a pure function of the timeline; the box fill, border, and checkmark draw are keyframed presets.

name: checkout-flow
title: UI Checkout Flow
desc: A cursor-driven checkout card: the card and its fields blur-in, then the pointer flips a billing-cycle toggle, types a card number, ticks the terms checkbox, and presses Pay through to success, ending in a toast. A pure orchestrator — every channel comes from a composed primitive's transition hook.

name: chevron-run
title: Chevron Run
desc: A giant gradient chevron frames a big +312% with a serif caption underneath.

name: chord-ring
title: Chord Ring
desc: Chords link a ring of integration names around a glowing center that reads "Connects to everything".

name: chore-fold
title: Chore Fold
desc: A teal "Captions does all of that." folds the chore away, "You just talk." beneath.

name: chromatic-wave
title: Chromatic Wave
desc: A soft wave travels down through the type; where it crosses, the letters ripple and split into RGB fringes.

name: chunk-stack
title: Chunk Stack
desc: "learn motion by making it" stacks one word per line with a yellow highlighter on "making".

name: churn-count
title: Churn Count
desc: A huge frame counter reaches 72,960 under a small blue caption on black.

name: claude-chat
title: Claude Chat
desc: Animated Claude chat input — types a prompt character-by-character and the waveform button morphs into a terracotta send button the moment text appears. Warm light/dark themes.

name: claude-code
title: Claude Code
desc: Animated Claude Code CLI welcome screen — terminal window with a dashed welcome box, recent activity and what's new panels, and a prompt line that types a command with a block cursor. Dark/light themes.

name: clock-sweep
title: Clock Sweep
desc: A clock hand sweeps a glowing wedge as the line From idea to video in 4 minutes appears.

name: cloth-reveal
title: Cloth Reveal
desc: A satin sheet draped over the content is yanked from one corner, folding and fluttering as a simulated cloth before it clears the frame.

name: code-morph
title: Code Morph
desc: A flat code editor that morphs between versions of a file, gliding each surviving token to its new line and column while removed code dissolves and new code fades in.

name: collab-lockup
title: Collab Lockup
desc: The Remocn logo and a partner logo join with an x under a glowing arc and caption.

name: color-bars
title: Color Bars
desc: Slanted fluted color bars whip across the frame and swap the outgoing shot for the incoming one.

name: column-reflow
title: Column Reflow
desc: A justified paragraph reflows its column width, redistributing lines with even word spacing.

name: column-slide
title: Column Slide
desc: Vertical columns slide in a stagger to swap one headline for another.

name: combo-counter
title: Combo Counter
desc: A gradient hit counter climbs to '12 HIT COMBO' with rating words like 'PERFECT'.

name: combobox
title: UI Combobox
desc: A combobox whose opened/closed state is a pure function of the timeline; the panel fade/scale/lift are keyframed presets like select. The trigger reuses the Input presets (typed query + caret reveal via an injected inputStyle), the list is filtered by a pure case-insensitive substring on the visible query prefix, and rows reuse the SelectItem row.

name: comet-headline
title: Comet Headline
desc: A headline and subhead arrive while a comet streaks arcs behind it, 'Every launch beat, already in orbit.'.

name: comic-panels
title: Comic Panels
desc: The frame cracks into a three-panel comic page with speed lines, red halftone and a starburst, then the action panel bursts into a full-frame POW.

name: command-menu
title: UI Command Menu
desc: A ⌘K command palette whose opened/closed state is a pure function of the timeline; the panel zoom + backdrop dim are dialog-like keyframed presets. The search row reveals the typed query, the list is filtered by a pure case-insensitive substring on the visible query prefix, and rows reuse the CommandMenuItem row.

name: command-menu-item
title: UI Command Menu Item
desc: A command-palette row whose idle/hover/press/selected state is a pure function of the timeline. Leading icon + label + trailing shortcut kbd. Exports an inline CommandMenuItemRow (reused by CommandMenu) and a standalone CommandMenuItem atom; the row background, label color, and icon color are keyframed presets.

name: compact-stat
title: Compact Stat
desc: A big 1.2M with a blue-gradient suffix sits above a small caption on a dark ground.

name: concentric-scale
title: Concentric Scale
desc: Concentric dotted discs scale from 1 to 1,000 while 100,000 creators lands beside the glowing last disc.

name: confetti
title: Confetti
desc: Deterministic confetti burst for Remotion — seeded particles with gravity, spin, and flutter so every render is identical. Fire it on any frame as a celebratory overlay.

name: context-menu
title: UI Context Menu
desc: A right-click context menu whose opened/closed state is a pure function of the timeline; the panel scales from its top-left corner (the click point) with a fade + lift. No trigger — the caller positions it. Rows reuse the DropdownMenuItem row; items are plain string labels.

name: contribution-heatmap
title: Contribution Heatmap
desc: A pixel heatmap fills in under a counter rolling up to 12,480 renders.

name: cool-down
title: Cool Down
desc: A short statement, 'Runs cool.', settles in large over a faint grid with a mono caption.

name: cooling-type
title: Cooling Type
desc: "What if your launch video could write itself?" cools in, ending on an italic word and a caret.

name: core-sum
title: Core Sum
desc: A monospace figure sums up to 2,097,152 beside a divider and a small caption.

name: countdown
title: Countdown
desc: A monumental countdown numeral inside a ring resolves into a Live lockup.

name: counter-reveal
title: Counter Reveal
desc: A huge front word reveals through the counters of its letters on a blue gradient.

name: coupon-apply
title: Coupon Apply
desc: A checkout order summary rejects a coupon, accepts another and the total drops.

name: cover-ring
title: Cover Ring
desc: An audio-style bar meter sits above the line "They're composed" over green light.

name: coy-denial
title: Coy Denial
desc: A huge "Don't check the site at nine." with a sheepish "(Do.)" tucked into the corner.

name: crash-zoom
title: Crash Zoom
desc: A calm serif tease crash-zooms into a huge gradient '1 DAY.' with speed lines.

name: crew-of-one
title: Crew of One
desc: A credits roll, Written by / Directed by / Shipped by, all pointing at a big "you".

name: crosshair-lock
title: Crosshair Lock
desc: A crosshair locks onto the peak of a dot plot and calls out 2.4k per minute.

name: crt-screen
title: CRT Screen
desc: Put a scene behind curved glass: the picture bulges out to the corners, an RGB phosphor mask and scanlines ride the curve, bright areas flood the mask, and the tube falls away into darkness at the rim.

name: crumple-toss
title: Crumple Toss
desc: Crushes an element into a ball of paper and throws it out of frame on an arc, leaving the scene around it running.

name: crunch
title: Crunch
desc: A timestamped story line, "It shipped, with time to ...", fades in over a dark brown ground.

name: cta-collapse-mark
title: CTA Collapse Mark
desc: Call-to-action content collapses into the Remocn wordmark over a glowing planet horizon.

name: cue-word
title: Cue Word
desc: A cue word triggers a slide, drop or lift cut to the next line on a pink ground.

name: cursor
title: UI Cursor
desc: An animated cursor that moves between waypoints, clicks (ripple), and drags. The Cursor renderer is a pure function of a numeric CursorStyle channel; useCursorPath reads the frame and eases the path, ripple, and press phases.

name: cursor-frame
title: Cursor Frame
desc: A selection frame with handles and a size badge is dragged around a two-line headline.

name: cursor-gravity
title: Cursor Gravity
desc: A rounded triangular cursor tugs a button out of the screen edge with pulsed elastic resistance.

name: cut-off
title: Cut Off
desc: A line is cut off by a white reply card: "Or let the code cut it.".

name: cut-stat
title: Cut Stat
desc: A blue bar graph wipes upward beside a big minus 44% caption, 'less time to a finished cut'.

name: deadpan-box
title: Deadpan Box
desc: A flat, deadpan quote in a blue box with a small attribution line.

name: deploy-pipeline
title: Deploy Pipeline
desc: A deployment page runs a build, streams logs and flips to Ready.

name: depth-headline
title: Depth Headline
desc: A huge serif headline sits behind a gradient sphere that slides through it for depth.

name: design-audit
title: Design Audit
desc: A full design review in one scene: redlines and issue boxes, a scan that ships the fix, a camera push into one card with specs and tokens, then layout guides.

name: device-grows-around
title: Device Grows Around
desc: A live plays counter card grows a device frame around it, with range tabs and delta stats.

name: device-morph
title: Device Morph
desc: A design canvas switches a frame between desktop, tablet and phone layouts.

name: diagonal-split
title: Diagonal Split
desc: A diagonal seam slides one scene away to reveal the next with a warm band.

name: dialog
title: UI Dialog
desc: A modal dialog whose opened/closed state is a pure function of the timeline; the backdrop dim and popup zoom are keyframed presets, with a close button and a primary action. Self-contained — pair it with the Button as a trigger (see the example).

name: diff-swap
title: Diff Swap
desc: A before line is diffed into the after line, ending 'Install the scene. Edit the props.'.

name: diminuendo
title: Diminuendo
desc: Huge counter climbs to 860,000 while each trailing digit group fades quieter than the last.

name: disc-pop
title: Disc Pop
desc: A disc pops open from a play button into a full video player scene.

name: displacement
title: Displacement
desc: The frame breaks into a grid of cells that shear apart into offset, colour-fringed tiles under film grain, then settle back carrying the next scene.

name: distribution-shift
title: Distribution Shift
desc: A latency distribution curve collapses left while 120ms and -86% appear.

name: dither-dissolve
title: Dither Dissolve
desc: A dithering shader transition that dissolves one scene into the next.

name: dolly-zoom
title: Dolly Zoom
desc: The vertigo shot: a perspective corridor with a red door stretches deeper while the subject in the center holds its exact size.

name: domino-run
title: Domino Run
desc: Dominoes fall in a chain, growing larger until a 10x stat is set off.

name: dot-field-morph
title: Dot Field Morph
desc: A drifting field of dots swirls into icon shapes, then gathers into the logo.

name: dot-globe
title: Dot Globe
desc: A dotted globe spins up while Live in 142 countries counts in beside it.

name: dot-map
title: Dot Map
desc: A dotted world map lights up city by city, ending on 142 countries.

name: dot-sort
title: Dot Sort
desc: Dots sort into rows by group, the logo row largest at 41%.

name: dot-type
title: Dot Type
desc: Words are drawn from a field of round dots in a gradient, the last one in accent.

name: double-take
title: Double Take
desc: "Read that again." above an oversized pink "One person" on blue.

name: drawer
title: UI Drawer
desc: A bottom panel whose opened/closed state is a pure function of the timeline; the backdrop dim and bottom-edge slide-up are keyframed presets, with a drag handle and a primary action. Self-contained — pair it with the Button as a trigger (see the example).

name: drift
title: Drift
desc: A slow linear camera push-in wrapper that scales its scene from 1 to 1+grow across the sequence so no frame is ever static.

name: drop-timer
title: Drop Timer
desc: A countdown to a drop ends in a huge gradient 'LIVE NOW' with a URL and logo.

name: drop-upload
title: Drop Upload
desc: A file card drops in and fills an upload bar until a check confirms it.

name: dropdown-menu
title: UI Dropdown Menu
desc: A dropdown menu whose opened/closed state is a pure function of the timeline; the trigger reuses the Button primitive and the reveal panel composes DropdownMenuItem rows. The panel fade, scale, lift, and chevron are keyframed presets.

name: dropdown-menu-item
title: UI Dropdown Menu Item
desc: A dropdown menu action row whose idle/hover/press state is a pure function of the timeline; the row background and label color are keyframed presets. Composed inside the DropdownMenu panel.

name: duet-split
title: Duet Split
desc: A split screen contrasts a slow grey side with a crisp gradient side: '1 day' versus '$0'.

name: dumbbell-shift
title: Dumbbell Shift
desc: Dumbbell rows slide their before and after dots apart, with a +16 summary.

name: duotone-beat
title: Duotone Beat
desc: A two-ink halftone portrait swaps its ink pair on every beat, with a punch-in on the downbeat and a bar indicator.

name: dynamic-letter
title: Dynamic Letter
desc: The wordmark appears while one letter morphs through shapes before settling as the final O.

name: echo-stack
title: Echo Stack
desc: A word focuses in at the center while outline copies of it unfold above and below and keep drifting, like the one clear line on a spinning drum.

name: ecosystem-constellation
title: Ecosystem Constellation
desc: A central logo orbited by integration satellites with pulsing data lines.

name: edge-fit
title: Edge Fit
desc: A single huge cream word, 'recaps', fills the frame edge to edge with a caption and logo.

name: edit-ripple
title: Edit Ripple
desc: "Change your mind, render it again." with the second line indented and ripple-coloured.

name: ellipsis-resolve
title: Ellipsis Resolve
desc: Three dots pulse and resolve into a gradient word and a closing period.

name: embargo-lift
title: Embargo Lift
desc: "remocn is free, open source and out today" in condensed type with a green accent.

name: ember-burn
title: Ember Burn
desc: The outgoing frame catches fire where it is brightest, boils in the heat, chars at the rim, and blows away as sparks carrying its own colour.

name: embossed-mark
title: Embossed Mark
desc: The R mark and wordmark are debossed into a brushed grey surface as it lights up.

name: enhance-count
title: Enhance Count
desc: A blurred line sharpens in place, 'Draft it fast. Finish it sharp.', the last word accented.

name: escalate-cards
title: Escalate Cards
desc: Cards flash one word each, accelerating until the last word fills the frame over a date.

name: exactly
title: Exactly
desc: A yellow "Exactly." lands first, then "It's just code." completes the answer.

name: exploded-view
title: Exploded View
desc: An isometric stack of slabs springs apart with leader lines and labels, holds, then clicks back together.

name: extrude-pop
title: Extrude Pop
desc: A flat word pops up out of the plane on a solid colored 3D body, no camera involved.

name: factor-out
title: Factor Out
desc: Three short imperatives stack above a big blue "in your editor.".

name: fade-through
title: Fade Through
desc: A Material-style content transition: old fades out, new fades in with a soft delay.

name: feather-settle
title: Feather Settle
desc: "Your launch, landing softly." settles in as if falling like a feather on a taupe ground.

name: feature-chips-flow
title: Feature Chips Flow
desc: Rows of feature pills stream by, then snap into a cluster around the logo.

name: feature-flag-rollout
title: Feature Flag Rollout
desc: A feature flag rolls out to 100% while error rate guardrails stay green.

name: feature-headline
title: Feature Headline
desc: A tag pill opens from the left, then a headline rises: 'Captions that move with every word.'.

name: feature-trio
title: Feature Trio
desc: Three feature words, 'Fast. Composable. Open source.', rise from masks with progress ticks and notes.

name: field
title: UI Field
desc: A static layout family for composing labeled form controls, modeled on shadcn's Field: FieldGroup ▸ Field ▸ FieldLabel / FieldControl / FieldDescription. Reads no frame and holds no state — colors come from the resolved theme. FieldControl is a relative fixed-height slot for the absolute remocn-ui controls (Input, Button).

name: figure-reels
title: Figure Reels
desc: A $400M figure announces itself between two scrolling image reels.

name: figure-to-label
title: Figure to Label
desc: A $6.4B figure resolves into its label "valuation" under the Remocn mark.

name: file-dropzone
title: File Dropzone
desc: Files drop into a knowledge base list and an upload toast confirms.

name: filler-cut
title: Filler Cut
desc: A transcript has its filler words cut, leaving a clean line, 'Ship your launch video today.'.

name: fine-print-up
title: Fine Print Up
desc: "No account and no watermark. Ever." in a big serif with tiny fine print at the bottom.

name: first-light
title: First Light
desc: The remocn wordmark is swept by a band of light along a baseline, with a tagline below.

name: flank-roll-swap
title: Flank Roll Swap
desc: "Out now ... on remocn.dev" rolls its flanking words around a sunset image in the middle.

name: flash-count
title: Flash Count
desc: A counter lands on 3,600 with a camera-flash pop, an exposure eyebrow in the corner.

name: flash-sweep
title: Flash Sweep
desc: A tilted band of light sweeps across the frame and swaps one shot for the next.

name: flick-swap
title: Flick Swap
desc: A headline flicks into place with a gradient second line, 'Grounds that never sit still.'.

name: flip-sting
title: Flip Sting
desc: The logo flips into place with a small tracked line settling under it.

name: flock-form
title: Flock Form
desc: A flock of birds flies in, forms an arrow, then settles into the R mark.

name: flood-sting
title: Flood Sting
desc: A flood of blue fills the frame and the Remocn wordmark lands between two dots.

name: flow-arrow
title: Flow Arrow
desc: A dotted gradient arrow zigzags upward beside a 3x growth stat.

name: flow-builder
title: Flow Builder
desc: A workflow canvas connects nodes, branches by plan and publishes with a toast.

name: flow-field
title: Flow Field
desc: Hundreds of particles ride a seeded noise field, leaving silky fading trails in a seamless loop.

name: fluted-glass
title: Fluted Glass
desc: Fluted glass refracts a gradient orb and its headline, clearing as it comes into focus.

name: focus-blur-resolve
title: Focus Blur Resolve
desc: A premium focus pull from heavy blur to crisp text, then a soft blur-out exit.

name: focus-front-swap
title: Focus Front Swap
desc: A headline pulls focus front-to-back to swap its last word to "tonight".
